requirements.title: Member registration
requirements.story: As a member, I want to create an account with my university email so that my meal responses are tied to me.
acceptance_criteria: Registration requires a valid email and password
Email must be verified before the account is active
Duplicate emails are rejected

requirements.title: Login, logout and password reset
requirements.story: As a user, I want to log in, log out and reset a forgotten password so that I can access my account securely.
acceptance_criteria: Valid credentials start a session; invalid ones show a generic error
Password reset link is emailed and expires after 1 hour
Logout ends the session on that device

requirements.title: Role-based access
requirements.story: As a chapter admin, I want users assigned roles (Member, Kitchen Staff, House Director, Chapter Admin) so that each person sees only what they need.
acceptance_criteria: Each user has exactly one role per chapter
Permissions are enforced on the server, not only hidden in the UI
Only Chapter Admins can change roles

requirements.title: Chapter setup and join code
requirements.story: As a chapter admin, I want to create my house and invite members with a join code so that onboarding a whole chapter is fast.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can create a chapter with name, address and timezone
A join code is generated and can be regenerated
Members who join with the code are pending until approved

requirements.title: Roster management
requirements.story: As a chapter admin, I want to approve, remove and label members as live-in or live-out so that the roster matches who actually eats at the house.
acceptance_criteria: Admin can approve or reject pending members
Admin can deactivate a member without deleting history
Each member is labeled live-in or live-out

requirements.title: Meal plan types
requirements.story: As a house director, I want to assign each member a meal plan (e.g., full, lunch-only, none) so that only eligible members appear in each meal's count.
acceptance_criteria: Plans define which meals a member is eligible for
Ineligible members cannot sign in to those meals
Changing a plan affects future meals only

requirements.title: Recurring meal schedule
requirements.story: As a house director, I want to define the weekly meal schedule with serve times and a sign-out cutoff for each meal so that members know the deadlines.
acceptance_criteria: Each meal has a name, days of week, serve time and cutoff
Meals are generated for the semester from the template
Cutoff is stored in the chapter's timezone

requirements.title: Schedule exceptions
requirements.story: As a house director, I want to cancel or add individual meals for holidays, breaks and chapter events so that the schedule reflects reality.
acceptance_criteria: A single meal or a date range can be cancelled
One-off meals can be added
Cancelled meals are hidden from members and excluded from reports

requirements.title: Post menu
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want to post the menu for each meal so that members can decide whether to eat.
acceptance_criteria: Staff can add or edit menu text per meal
Menu changes after posting are timestamped

requirements.title: View upcoming meals
requirements.story: As a member, I want to see the upcoming meals, their cutoffs and my current status so that I don't miss a deadline.
acceptance_criteria: Shows at least the next 7 days of meals
Each meal shows serve time, cutoff, my status and menu if posted

requirements.title: Default attendance mode
requirements.story: As a house director, I want to choose whether members are counted in or out by default so that the system matches how my house already works.
acceptance_criteria: Chapter setting: default-in (sign out to skip) or default-out (sign in to eat)
Default applies to every eligible member for every generated meal
Changing the mode affects future meals only

requirements.title: Sign in / sign out of a meal
requirements.story: As a member, I want to change my status for a meal in two taps or fewer so that responding is effortless.
acceptance_criteria: Status toggles from the meal list without opening another page
Change is reflected in the live headcount within 5 seconds
Confirmation is shown to the member

requirements.title: Cutoff enforcement
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want changes locked after the cutoff so that the count I cook for doesn't move.
acceptance_criteria: Members cannot change status after cutoff
Staff and House Director can still override with a note
UI shows a countdown to cutoff

requirements.title: Standing weekly preferences
requirements.story: As a member, I want to set recurring preferences (e.g., always out for Friday dinner) so that I don't have to respond every week.
acceptance_criteria: Member can set a preference per meal slot
Preferences apply to newly generated meals
One-off changes override the standing preference

requirements.title: Bulk sign-out for a date range
requirements.story: As a member, I want to sign out of every meal between two dates so that I can handle trips and breaks at once.
acceptance_criteria: Member picks a start and end date
All eligible meals in range are set to out
Meals past cutoff are not changed

requirements.title: Guests
requirements.story: As a member, I want to add guests to a meal so that the kitchen accounts for visitors.
acceptance_criteria: Member can add 1-3 guests per meal before cutoff
Guests are shown separately in the headcount
House Director can disable guests

requirements.title: Attendance change log
requirements.story: As a house director, I want a log of who changed what and when so that disputes can be resolved.
acceptance_criteria: Every status change records user, old value, new value and timestamp
Log is read-only and filterable by member and meal

requirements.title: Request a late plate
requirements.story: As a member, I want to request a late plate before the cutoff with a pickup note so that I can eat when class runs late.
acceptance_criteria: Request available only before cutoff
Optional note (e.g., pickup time, no onions)
Requesting a late plate counts the member as eating

requirements.title: Late plate list and labels
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want a list of late plates with printable name labels so that I can package them without texts.
acceptance_criteria: List shows name, note and dietary flags
Labels print on a standard sheet

requirements.title: Late plate pickup tracking
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want to mark late plates picked up or not so that we can track waste from uncollected plates.
acceptance_criteria: Each late plate can be marked picked up / not picked up
Uncollected late plates feed waste reports

requirements.title: Live headcount
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want a live count of who is eating each meal so that I know how much to prepare.
acceptance_criteria: Shows total in, total out, guests and late plates
Updates without a page refresh
Shows today's meals first

requirements.title: Final count at cutoff
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want the count frozen at cutoff with a timestamp so that I have a reliable number to cook to.
acceptance_criteria: Final count is saved when cutoff passes
Later overrides are shown as adjustments, not silent changes

requirements.title: Kitchen tablet view
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want a large, glanceable view for a kitchen tablet so that I can check the count while cooking.
acceptance_criteria: Large-type layout readable from about 2 meters
Stays awake / auto-refreshes during meal windows

requirements.title: Manual count adjustment
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want to record walk-ins and the number actually served so that the data reflects reality.
acceptance_criteria: Staff enter actual served count after the meal
Adjustments require a short reason

requirements.title: Dietary profile
requirements.story: As a member, I want to record my dietary restrictions and allergies once so that the kitchen always knows.
acceptance_criteria: Choose from a standard list (vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, nut allergy, etc.) plus free text
Member can edit or clear the profile at any time

requirements.title: Dietary breakdown on headcount
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want each meal's count broken down by restriction so that I prepare the right number of alternate plates.
acceptance_criteria: Shows counts per restriction for members marked in
Severe allergies are visually highlighted

requirements.title: Allergy flags on late plate labels
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want allergy flags printed on late plate labels so that a plate never goes to the wrong person.
acceptance_criteria: Labels include allergy icons/text for that member

requirements.title: Dietary data visibility
requirements.story: As a member, I want my dietary and allergy information visible only to kitchen staff and the house director so that my health information stays private.
acceptance_criteria: Other members cannot see dietary data
Access is enforced server-side by role

requirements.title: Cutoff reminders
requirements.story: As a member, I want a reminder before cutoff so that I remember to update my status.
acceptance_criteria: Reminder sent a configurable time before cutoff (default 2 hours)
Delivered by push or email

requirements.title: Meal change alerts
requirements.story: As a member, I want to be notified when a meal is cancelled or the menu changes so that I can adjust my plans.
acceptance_criteria: Cancellation alerts go to everyone signed in to that meal
Menu change alerts are opt-in

requirements.title: Notification preferences
requirements.story: As a member, I want to control which notifications I get and how so that the app isn't annoying.
acceptance_criteria: Per-type on/off toggles
Choose push, email or both

requirements.title: Store attendance actuals
requirements.story: As a house director, I want every meal's final count, adjustments and actual served stored so that we can analyze attendance over time.
acceptance_criteria: One record per meal with final count, adjustments, served count and late plates
Data retained for at least 2 academic years

requirements.title: Calendar event tags
requirements.story: As a house director, I want to tag dates (exam week, home game, break, chapter event) so that forecasts account for unusual days.
acceptance_criteria: Tags apply to a date or date range
Tags are visible on the meal schedule

requirements.title: Baseline turnout forecast
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want a predicted turnout for upcoming meals based on history so that I can plan before members respond.
acceptance_criteria: Forecast uses a moving average by meal and day of week
Shown beside the live count for meals in the next 7 days
Hidden until at least 3 weeks of data exist

requirements.title: Event-adjusted forecast
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want forecasts adjusted for exam weeks, game days and breaks so that predictions stay accurate on unusual days.
acceptance_criteria: Forecast applies a learned adjustment factor per tag
Shows which tags influenced the prediction

requirements.title: Forecast accuracy report
requirements.story: As a house director, I want to compare forecast vs. actual so that I know whether to trust the predictions.
acceptance_criteria: Shows forecast, actual and error for each past meal
Reports mean absolute error per meal type

requirements.title: Attendance and waste reports
requirements.story: As a house director, I want reports on no-show rates, late plate pickup and attendance trends, exportable to CSV, so that I can reduce waste and justify budget decisions.
acceptance_criteria: Filter by date range and meal
Includes no-show rate (counted in but not served)
Export to CSV

requirements.title: Portion and ingredient suggestions
requirements.story: As kitchen staff, I want ingredient quantities suggested from the forecast and recipe yields so that ordering is less guesswork.
acceptance_criteria: Recipes store yield per serving
Suggested quantities scale with the forecast

requirements.title: Food cost tracking
requirements.story: As a chapter treasurer, I want cost per meal and per member tracked so that the chapter can see the money saved by reducing waste.
acceptance_criteria: Staff enter grocery spend per week
Reports cost per meal served

requirements.title: Mobile-first responsive UI
requirements.story: The member interface shall be fully usable on phone screens 360px wide and up.
acceptance_criteria: All member flows work at 360px width without horizontal scrolling

requirements.title: Response time
requirements.story: Sign-in/out actions shall complete in under 1 second at the 95th percentile for a chapter of 150 members.
acceptance_criteria: Load test with 150 concurrent users meets the target

requirements.title: Security baseline
requirements.story: The system shall hash passwords, use HTTPS everywhere and enforce role permissions server-side.
acceptance_criteria: Passwords hashed with a modern algorithm (bcrypt/argon2)
No endpoint returns data outside the user's role

requirements.title: Health data privacy
requirements.story: Dietary and allergy data shall be collected minimally, visible only to authorized roles and deletable by the member.
acceptance_criteria: Member can delete their dietary profile
Access to dietary data is logged

requirements.title: Timezone correctness
requirements.story: All schedules and cutoffs shall be evaluated in the chapter's local timezone, including daylight saving changes.
acceptance_criteria: Cutoffs fire correctly across a DST transition in tests

requirements.title: Headcount consistency
requirements.story: Concurrent status changes near the cutoff shall never produce an incorrect final count.
acceptance_criteria: Simultaneous updates are serialized or transactional
Final count equals the sum of stored statuses

requirements.title: Availability during meal windows
requirements.story: The system shall be available 99% of the time during meal windows.
acceptance_criteria: Uptime monitoring and alerting in place

requirements.title: Accessibility
requirements.story: The UI shall meet WCAG 2.1 AA.
acceptance_criteria: Passes automated accessibility checks
Fully usable with keyboard and screen reader

requirements.title: Multi-chapter data isolation
requirements.story: Data for each chapter shall be isolated so that houses never see each other's data.
acceptance_criteria: Every query is scoped by chapter
Automated tests verify cross-chapter access is denied
